title: (0Day) Krita HEIC File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Krita. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The issue results from the use of a vulnerable version of libheif. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
